::: {.content-visible when-profile="id"}
1. Tutorial dirilis satu per satu setiap minggu, dikerjakan di sesi lab hari Rabu (Sesi 2).
2. Tutorial **tidak wajib** dikerjakan dan tidak dinilai langsung — namun **beberapa tutorial menjadi prasyarat** sebelum Tugas/milestone tertentu bisa dinilai. Perhatikan catatan prasyarat di setiap halaman Tugas.
3. Mahasiswa dapat bertanya kepada asisten dosen selama jam sesi lab.
4. Sangat disarankan tetap mengerjakan tiap tutorial — pola yang dipelajari di tutorial langsung dipakai ulang di proyek individu kamu sendiri (lihat menu Tugas).
:::
::: {.content-visible when-profile="en"}
1. Tutorials are released one at a time each week, worked on during the Wednesday (Session 2) lab session.
2. Tutorials are **not mandatory** and are not graded directly — however **some tutorials are a prerequisite** before a specific Tugas/milestone can be graded. Check the prerequisite note on each Tugas page.
3. Students may ask teaching assistants questions during the lab session.
4. Doing each tutorial is still strongly recommended — the pattern you learn there gets reused directly in your own individual project (see the Assignments menu).
:::
